description.value: Brass Monkey Taproom is a craft microbrewery and taproom on Bay Street in Victoria, brewing its own beer on-site and serving a food menu that includes burgers and wings. The venue runs a packed weekly events calendar — trivia leagues, specialty cask tappings, bingo nights, and live DJ sets — giving it a lively neighbourhood pub atmosphere. It sits a short ride from Victoria's inner harbour in a mixed residential-commercial area, making it a natural end-of-ride destination for cyclists exploring the city.
